reason: My viewer already opens my screenshots and PNG exports instantly, and I do not want to relearn keys or re-tick file associations for a v0.4.1 from one guy. I would try the portable zip on my DDS/EXR/GLB files and keep it around for those.
why_switch_or_not: The only part that interests me is that it lists TGA, DDS, EXR, HDR, GLB and FBX, which my current viewer does not handle well. For hundreds of PNG screenshots a day I see no gain, since 40 ms vs 50 ms next/back is nothing I can feel. I would not make it default because it is a single-developer 0.4.1 and I would have to redo the associations by hand.
current_app_pros: Tiny, opens instantly, next/back is fast, keys I have used for years, no clutter. It just shows the picture and gets out of the way.
current_app_pains: Nothing much for PNG and screenshots. It does not open EXR/HDR/DDS/3D files, so I jump to another tool for those, but that is a small thing.
objection: Colour management. I do not want an app that changes how my textures and exports look (gamma, ICC, alpha on TGA/DDS) compared with what I see in my other tools, and I do not trust a young app on that until I have checked it myself.
would_change_my_mind: If I compared it on my own TGA/DDS/EXR files (alpha, sRGB vs linear) and saw it show them correctly and consistently, and it proved stable for a few weeks, I would think about making it default.
